-- clinicschedules/upsert (alta, script 139): una fila por cada día elegido,
-- con el mismo rango. Días 0=domingo..6=sábado; acepta también day_of_week
-- escalar. Un día que ya tiene ese mismo rango en la sede no se duplica.
WITH v AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
d AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x::int AS day_of_week
  FROM v, jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.j->'days_of_week') = 'array' THEN v.j->'days_of_week' ELSE jsonb_build_array(v.j->'day_of_week') END) x
  WHERE NULLIF(x, '') IS NOT NULL
)
INSERT INTO public.clinic_schedules (day_of_week, start_time, end_time, sede_id, created_at)
SELECT d.day_of_week, (v.j->>'start_time')::time, (v.j->>'end_time')::time, (v.j->>'sede_id')::int, now()
FROM v, d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.clinic_schedules cs
  WHERE cs.sede_id = (v.j->>'sede_id')::int
    AND cs.day_of_week = d.day_of_week
    AND cs.start_time = (v.j->>'start_time')::time
    AND cs.end_time = (v.j->>'end_time')::time
)
RETURNING id;

-- Normaliza el body de feriados/upsert (script 138): una excepción lleva la
-- lista de días de su recurrencia en dates / days_of_week / days_of_month.
-- Acepta también el formato viejo (date / day_of_week / day_of_month escalares).
WITH v AS (
  SELECT j, COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'recurrence', ''), 'once') AS recurrence
  FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j) b
),
p AS (
  SELECT
    v.j,
    v.recurrence,
    CASE WHEN v.recurrence = 'once' THEN (
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x::date ORDER BY x::date)
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.j->'dates') = 'array' THEN v.j->'dates' ELSE jsonb_build_array(v.j->'date') END) x
      WHERE NULLIF(x, '') IS NOT NULL
    ) END AS dates,
    CASE WHEN v.recurrence IN ('weekly', 'biweekly') THEN (
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x::smallint ORDER BY x::smallint)
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.j->'days_of_week') = 'array' THEN v.j->'days_of_week' ELSE jsonb_build_array(v.j->'day_of_week') END) x
      WHERE NULLIF(x, '') IS NOT NULL
    ) END AS days_of_week,
    CASE WHEN v.recurrence = 'monthly' THEN (
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x::smallint ORDER BY x::smallint)
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.j->'days_of_month') = 'array' THEN v.j->'days_of_month' ELSE jsonb_build_array(v.j->'day_of_month') END) x
      WHERE NULLIF(x, '') IS NOT NULL
    ) END AS days_of_month,
    -- La paridad quincenal se cuenta desde el lunes de la semana de referencia.
    CASE WHEN v.recurrence = 'biweekly' THEN date_trunc('week', NULLIF(v.j->>'biweekly_reference_date', '')::date)::date END AS biweekly_reference_date,
    CASE WHEN v.recurrence <> 'once' THEN NULLIF(v.j->>'end_date', '')::date END AS end_date
  FROM v
)
UPDATE public.clinic_exceptions ce SET
  date = CASE WHEN p.recurrence = 'once' THEN p.dates[1] ELSE NULLIF(p.j->>'date', '')::date END,
  dates = p.dates,
  is_open = COALESCE((p.j->>'is_open')::boolean, false),
  start_time = NULLIF(p.j->>'start_time', '')::time,
  end_time = NULLIF(p.j->>'end_time', '')::time,
  notes = p.j->>'notes',
  sede_id = NULLIF(p.j->>'sede_id', '')::int,
  recurrence = p.recurrence,
  days_of_week = p.days_of_week,
  days_of_month = p.days_of_month,
  biweekly_reference_date = p.biweekly_reference_date,
  end_date = p.end_date,
  -- Columnas escalares reemplazadas por los arrays (script 138).
  day_of_week = NULL,
  day_of_month = NULL
FROM p
WHERE ce.id = (p.j->>'id')::int
RETURNING ce.id;

-- lista de días de su recurrencia en dates / days_of_week / days_of_month.
-- Acepta también el formato viejo (date / day_of_week / day_of_month escalares).
WITH v AS (

      WHERE NULLIF(x, '') IS NOT NULL
    ) END AS days_of_month,
    -- La paridad quincenal se cuenta desde el lunes de la semana de referencia.

INSERT INTO public.clinic_exceptions
  (date, dates, is_open, start_time, end_time, notes, sede_id, recurrence,
   days_of_week, days_of_month, biweekly_reference_date, end_date)
SELECT
  -- 'once': la primera fecha (orden de la lista); el resto: inicio de la recurrencia.
  CASE WHEN p.recurrence = 'once' THEN p.dates[1] ELSE NULLIF(p.j->>'date', '')::date END,
  p.dates,
  COALESCE((p.j->>'is_open')::boolean, false),
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'start_time', '')::time, '00:00:00'),
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p.j->>'end_time', '')::time, '23:59:59'),
  COALESCE(p.j->>'notes', ''),
  NULLIF(p.j->>'sede_id', '')::int,
  p.recurrence,
  p.days_of_week,
  p.days_of_month,
  p.biweekly_reference_date,
  p.end_date
FROM p
RETURNING id;

SELECT
  a.id,
  a.user_id,
  u.name AS user_name,
  a.recurrence,
  a.days_of_week,
  a.days_of_month,
  a.start_time,
  a.end_time,
  a.start_date::text,
  a.end_date::text,
  a.biweekly_reference_date::text,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total
FROM
  availability_rules a
INNER JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
WHERE
  -- 1. Tu filtro de búsqueda global existente (agrupado entre paréntesis)
  (
    COALESCE($1, '') = '' OR
    (
      u.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      -- a.recurrence ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.days_of_week::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.start_time::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.end_time::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.end_date::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    )
  )
  -- 2. NUEVO: Filtro opcional por user_id ($4)
  AND ($4 IS NULL OR $4::text = '' OR a.user_id = $4)
ORDER BY
  a.start_date DESC
LIMIT
  {{ $2 || 100 }}
OFFSET
  {{ (($3 || 1) - 1) * ($2 || 100) }};

SELECT
  a.id,
  a.user_id,
  u.name AS user_name,
  a.exception_date::TEXT,
  a.dates::TEXT[] AS dates,
  a.start_time,
  a.end_time,
  a.is_available,
  COUNT(*) OVER() AS total
FROM
  availability_exceptions a
INNER JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
WHERE
  -- 1. Buscador global existente protegido por paréntesis
  (
    COALESCE($1, '') = '' OR
    (
      u.name ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.dates::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.start_time::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%' OR
      a.end_time::text ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
    )
  )
  -- 2. NUEVO: Filtro opcional por user_id ($4)
  AND ($4 IS NULL OR $4::text = '' OR a.user_id = $4)
ORDER BY
  a.exception_date DESC
LIMIT
  {{ $2 || 100 }}
OFFSET
  {{ (($3 || 1) - 1) * ($2 || 100) }};

-- Normaliza el body de availability_rules/upsert (script 139): una regla lleva
-- la lista de días en days_of_week / days_of_month. Acepta también el formato
-- viejo (day_of_week / day_of_month escalares). 'daily' = lunes a viernes.
WITH v AS (
  SELECT j, COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'recurrence', ''), 'weekly') AS raw_recurrence
  FROM (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j) b
),
p AS (
  SELECT
    v.j,
    CASE WHEN v.raw_recurrence = 'daily' THEN 'weekly' ELSE v.raw_recurrence END AS recurrence,
    CASE
      WHEN v.raw_recurrence = 'daily' THEN '{1,2,3,4,5}'::smallint[]
      WHEN v.raw_recurrence IN ('weekly', 'biweekly') THEN (
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x::smallint ORDER BY x::smallint)
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.j->'days_of_week') = 'array' THEN v.j->'days_of_week' ELSE jsonb_build_array(v.j->'day_of_week') END) x
      WHERE NULLIF(x, '') IS NOT NULL
    )
    END AS days_of_week,
    CASE WHEN v.raw_recurrence = 'monthly' THEN (
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x::smallint ORDER BY x::smallint)
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.j->'days_of_month') = 'array' THEN v.j->'days_of_month' ELSE jsonb_build_array(v.j->'day_of_month') END) x
      WHERE NULLIF(x, '') IS NOT NULL
    ) END AS days_of_month,
    -- Paridad quincenal desde el lunes de la semana de referencia (sin
    -- referencia, la de la fecha de inicio).
    CASE WHEN v.raw_recurrence = 'biweekly' THEN
      date_trunc('week', COALESCE(NULLIF(v.j->>'biweekly_reference_date', ''), v.j->>'start_date')::date)::date
    END AS biweekly_reference_date
  FROM v
)
UPDATE public.availability_rules r SET
  user_id = (p.j->>'user_id')::uuid,
  recurrence = p.recurrence::recurrence_type,
  days_of_week = p.days_of_week,
  days_of_month = p.days_of_month,
  start_time = (p.j->>'start_time')::time,
  end_time = (p.j->>'end_time')::time,
  start_date = (p.j->>'start_date')::date,
  end_date = NULLIF(p.j->>'end_date', '')::date,
  biweekly_reference_date = p.biweekly_reference_date,
  -- Columnas escalares reemplazadas por los arrays (script 139).
  day_of_week = NULL,
  day_of_month = NULL
FROM p
WHERE r.id = (p.j->>'id')::int
RETURNING r.id;

-- Normaliza el body de availability_exceptions/upsert (script 139): una
-- excepción lleva todas sus fechas en `dates`; acepta también el formato viejo
-- (exception_date escalar).
WITH v AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
p AS (
  SELECT
    v.j,
    (
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT x::date ORDER BY x::date)
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(v.j->'dates') = 'array' THEN v.j->'dates' ELSE jsonb_build_array(v.j->'exception_date') END) x

UPDATE public.availability_exceptions e SET

  exception_date = p.dates[1],
  dates = p.dates,
  start_time = NULLIF(p.j->>'start_time', '')::time,
  end_time = NULLIF(p.j->>'end_time', '')::time,
  is_available = COALESCE((p.j->>'is_available')::boolean, false)

SELECT a.id AS appointment_id,
	a.summary,
	a.start_datetime AS start,
	a.end_datetime AS end,
	a.patient_id AS patient_id,
	u.name AS patient_name,
	u.phone_number AS patient_phone,
	u.email AS patient_email,
    u.identity_document as patient_identity_document,
    CASE WHEN u.responsible_contact_id IS NOT NULL THEN
        jsonb_build_object(
            'id', rc.id,
            'name', rc.name,
            'email', rc.email,
            'phone_number', rc.phone_number,
            'address', rc.address
        )
    ELSE NULL END AS responsible_contact,
	a.assignee_id AS doctor_id,
	d.name AS doctor_name,
	d.email AS doctor_email,
	a.description,
	a.status,
	a.cancellation_reason,
	a.cancellation_note,
	a.created_at,
	a.calendar_source_id,
	google_event_id AS google_event_id,
    a.color,
    a.invoice_id,
    a.notes,
    a.quote_id,
    a.imported_from_google,
    q.doc_no,
    COALESCE(s.services_array, '[]'::jsonb) AS services

FROM public.appointments a
INNER JOIN calendar_sources c ON c.id = a.calendar_source_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.patient_id
LEFT JOIN users rc ON rc.id = u.responsible_contact_id
LEFT JOIN users d ON d.id = a.assignee_id
-- Subconsulta para agregar los servicios por cada cita
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        asc_t.appointment_id,
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', sc.id,
                'name', sc.name,
                'price', sc.price
            )
        ) AS services_array
    FROM appointment_service_catalog asc_t
    INNER JOIN service_catalog sc ON asc_t.service_id = sc.id
    GROUP BY asc_t.appointment_id
) s ON s.appointment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN quotes q ON a.quote_id = q.id

WHERE (
  c.is_active IS TRUE 
  AND a.start_datetime >= $1 
  AND a.end_datetime <= $2
  AND ($3 IS NULL OR a.calendar_source_id = ANY (string_to_array($3, ',')::bigint[]))
  AND ($4 IS NULL OR a.patient_id = $4)
  AND ($6 IS NULL OR a.assignee_id = $6)
  AND $5 IS NULL
  AND a.status <> 'deleted'
)
OR ($5 IS NOT NULL AND a.id = $5)

SELECT 
    a.id, a.calendar_source_id, a.google_event_id, a.status
FROM appointments a
WHERE a.id = $1;

WITH existing AS (
  SELECT id, quote_id, user_id, status FROM orders WHERE quote_id = $1
),
new_order AS (
  INSERT INTO orders (quote_id, user_id, status, created_at)
  SELECT $1, $2, 'Pending', NOW()
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
  RETURNING id, quote_id, user_id, status
)
SELECT id, quote_id, user_id, status FROM new_order
UNION ALL
SELECT id, quote_id, user_id, status FROM existing
LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, quote_item_id, status, scheduled_date)
SELECT $1, qi.id, 'scheduled', $2::timestamptz
FROM quote_items qi
WHERE qi.quote_id = $3
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi
  WHERE oi.quote_item_id = qi.id AND oi.order_id = $1
)
RETURNING id, order_id, quote_item_id, status
UPDATE quotes SET status = 'confirmed', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND status NOT IN ('confirmed', 'rejected')

SELECT 
    a.id, a.google_calendar_id, a.google_event_id
FROM appointments a
WHERE a.id = $1;

WITH existing AS (

UNION ALL
SELECT id, quote_id, user_id, status FROM existing
LIMIT 1

SELECT $1, qi.id, 'scheduled', $2::timestamptz
FROM quote_items qi
WHERE qi.quote_id = $3
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi
  WHERE oi.quote_item_id = qi.id AND oi.order_id = $1
)
RETURNING id, order_id, quote_item_id, status
UPDATE quotes SET status = 'confirmed', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1 AND status NOT IN ('confirmed', 'rejected')

## Appointments – Reschedule

**POST** `/webhook/appointments/reschedule`

Cancels the original appointment and creates a new one in a single
transaction. Mirror of the `upsert` create payload plus the
`original_appointment_id` field.

**No side-effects in v1**: does NOT touch Google Calendar, does
NOT send notifications.

The link between the cancelled appointment and the new one is
NOT persisted as a relational FK — knowing the old was cancelled
with reason='reschedule' is enough.

**Cancellation:**
- old.status              = 'cancelled'
- old.cancellation_reason = 'reschedule'

**Creation:**
- new.status = 'scheduled'

**Eligibility:** the original must NOT be in a terminal state
(`completed`, `cancelled`, `no_show`). Otherwise → 409.

**Request body (same shape as upsert create + `original_appointment_id`):**
```json
{
  "original_appointment_id": "abc-123",
  "patient_id": "...",
  "patient_name": "...",
  "doctor_id": "...",
  "doctor_name": "...",
  "calendar_source_id": "...",
  "summary": "…",
  "notes": "…",
  "service_ids": ["svc-1", "svc-2"],
  "start": "2026-05-12T10:00:00",
  "end":   "2026-05-12T10:30:00",
  "changed_by": "user-id"
}
```

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "code": 200,
  "original_appointment_id": "abc-123",
  "new_appointment_id": "def-456"
}
```

## Appointments – Update Status

**POST** `/webhook/appointments/update_status`

Updates `appointments.status` and inserts an audit row in
`appointment_status_log`. No transition gating — the user is free
to move the appointment to any status. No side-effects (no Google
Calendar / no notifications).

**Allowed status values:**
- pending, scheduled, confirmed, arrived, in_progress,
  completed, no_show, cancelled

**No transition restrictions** — any source status can move to any
target status. The only no-op is staying in the same status.

**When status='cancelled', cancellation_reason is required:**
- late, in_time, no_notice, by_doctor, by_clinic, other
- 'reschedule' is BLOCKED here (only set by /appointments/reschedule)
- If reason='other', cancellation_note is required.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "appointment_id": "abc-123",
  "status": "cancelled",
  "cancellation_reason": "by_doctor",  // required if status='cancelled'
  "cancellation_note": "…",            // required if reason='other'
  "changed_by": "user-id",              // optional
  "note": "Notas extra para el log"     // optional, distinto del cancellation_note
}
```

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "code": 200,
  "appointment_id": "abc-123",
  "from_status": "scheduled",
  "status": "cancelled",
  "cancellation_reason": "by_doctor"
}
```

**Response 409 (no-op):**
```json
{ "error": true, "code": 409, "message": "Appointment is already in status \"cancelled\"" }
```

**Response 400 (validation error):**
```json
{ "error": true, "code": 400, "message": "cancellation_reason is required when status='cancelled'" }
```

## Reminders – Get

**GET** `/webhook/reminders`

Returns internal calendar reminders: the caller's own reminders (`created_by = jwt userId`) plus every `visibility = 'clinic'` reminder from any creator.

**Query params:**
- `from`: optional ISO/local datetime lower bound for `start_datetime`
- `to`: optional ISO/local datetime upper bound for `start_datetime`
- `status`: optional status filter (`pending`, `done`, `dismissed`, `cancelled`)
- `include_cancelled`: optional boolean; default false

**Response 200:** array of reminders using the frontend contract:
`id`, `title`, `description`, `start_datetime`, `end_datetime`, `color`, `priority`, `status`, `visibility` (`personal`|`clinic`), `raise_alert`, `alert_instance_id`, `created_by`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

**POST** `/webhook/reminders/delete`

Deletes an internal reminder. Only the creator (`created_by`, from the JWT) may delete it — a reminder owned by someone else, or a nonexistent id, returns 403.

  INSERT INTO appointments (
    patient_id, assignee_id, calendar_source_id,
    start_datetime, end_datetime,
    summary, notes, status,
    created_at, updated_at
  ) VALUES (
    $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'scheduled', NOW(), NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id::text AS new_id
),
cancelled_old AS (
  UPDATE appointments
  SET status              = $11,
      cancellation_reason = 'reschedule',
      updated_at          = NOW()
  WHERE id::text = $8
  RETURNING id::text AS old_id
),

  INSERT INTO appointment_status_log
    (appointment_id, from_status, to_status, cancellation_reason, changed_by, note)
  SELECT old_id, $9, 'cancelled', 'reschedule', $10, 'Reagendada'
  FROM cancelled_old
  RETURNING appointment_id
),
log_new AS (
  INSERT INTO appointment_status_log
    (appointment_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by, note)
  SELECT new_id, NULL, 'scheduled', $10, 'Creada por reagendamiento'
  FROM new_appt
  RETURNING appointment_id
)
SELECT (SELECT old_id FROM cancelled_old) AS old_id,
       (SELECT new_id FROM new_appt)     AS new_id;

INSERT INTO public.reminders AS existing (
  id,
  type,
  calendar_id,
  title,
  description,
  start_datetime,
  end_datetime,
  color,
  priority,
  status,
  visibility,
  raise_alert,
  created_by,
  completed_at,
  completed_by,
  created_at,
  updated_at
) VALUES (
  COALESCE($1::uuid, gen_random_uuid()),
  $2::character varying,
  $3::bigint,
  $4::text,
  $5::text,
  $6::timestamp,
  $7::timestamp,
  $8::character varying,
  $9::character varying,
  $10::character varying,
  $13::character varying,
  CASE WHEN $2::text = 'note' THEN FALSE ELSE $11::boolean END,
  $12::uuid,
  CASE WHEN $10::text = 'done' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,
  CASE WHEN $10::text = 'done' THEN $12::uuid ELSE NULL END,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE
SET type           = EXCLUDED.type,
    calendar_id    = EXCLUDED.calendar_id,
    title          = EXCLUDED.title,
    description    = EXCLUDED.description,
    start_datetime = EXCLUDED.start_datetime,
    end_datetime   = EXCLUDED.end_datetime,
    color          = EXCLUDED.color,
    priority       = EXCLUDED.priority,
    status         = EXCLUDED.status,
    visibility     = CASE
                       -- El alcance solo lo cambia el autor. Si B marcara "solo para mí"
                       -- un ítem de A, created_by seguiría siendo A: el ítem pasaría a ser
                       -- personal DE A y desaparecería del calendario de B, sin forma de
                       -- revertirlo desde la UI. Misma razón que isScopeLocked en el form.
                       WHEN existing.created_by IS NULL OR existing.created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by
                         THEN EXCLUDED.visibility
                       ELSE existing.visibility
                     END,
    raise_alert    = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.type = 'note' THEN FALSE ELSE EXCLUDED.raise_alert END,
    completed_at   = CASE
                       WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'done' THEN COALESCE(existing.completed_at, NOW())
                       ELSE NULL
                     END,
    completed_by   = CASE
                       WHEN EXCLUDED.status = 'done' THEN COALESCE(existing.completed_by, EXCLUDED.completed_by)
                       ELSE NULL
                     END,
    updated_at     = NOW()
-- Lo compartido lo edita cualquiera; lo personal, solo su autor. EXCLUDED.created_by es
-- el actor del JWT, así que esto compara "lo guardado" contra "quien edita".
--
-- El IS NULL no es defensivo de más: `NULL = 'uuid'` da NULL, no false, así que sin él
-- las filas sin autor (viejas, o con el autor dado de baja — la FK es ON DELETE SET NULL)
-- no las podría editar nadie, nunca.
WHERE existing.visibility <> 'personal'
   OR existing.created_by IS NULL
   OR existing.created_by = EXCLUDED.created_by
RETURNING
  id::text AS id,
  type,
  calendar_id::text AS calendar_id,
  title,
  description,
  start_datetime::text AS start_datetime,
  end_datetime::text AS end_datetime,
  color,
  priority,
  status,
  visibility,
  raise_alert,
  alert_instance_id,
  created_by::text AS created_by,
  created_at::text AS created_at,
  updated_at::text AS updated_at,
  completed_at::text AS completed_at,
  completed_by::text AS completed_by;

parameters.content:
## Reminders – Upsert

**POST** `/webhook/reminders/upsert`

Creates or updates a note or reminder. PostgreSQL receives every dynamic value through prepared-statement parameters; no request value is interpolated into SQL.

**Request body:**
```json
{
  "id": "optional-uuid",
  "type": "note | reminder",
  "calendar_id": "42 | null",
  "title": "Llamar a laboratorio",
  "description": "Detalles opcionales",
  "start_datetime": "2026-05-13T13:45:00",
  "end_datetime": "2026-05-13T14:00:00",
  "color": "#5484ed",
  "priority": "MEDIUM",
  "status": "pending",
  "visibility": "clinic | personal",
  "raise_alert": true
}
```

**Alcance (`visibility`)**
- `clinic` (compartido, el default): lo edita cualquier usuario del staff.
- `personal`: solo lo edita su autor (`created_by`). Un ítem sin autor — filas viejas o
  cuyo autor fue dado de baja, la FK es `ON DELETE SET NULL` — se trata como compartido.

La autorización vive en el `ON CONFLICT ... WHERE`, y `visibility` solo la cambia el
autor. Misma regla que `canManageReminder` en el frontend y que el filtro del GET.

`calendar_id` is nullable. `created_by` and completion ownership come from the authenticated JWT, never from the request body. Notes always persist with `raise_alert = false`. Alert scheduling remains the responsibility of the alert workflows; this endpoint does not create `alert_instances`.

**Response 200:** `{ "success": true, "code": 200, "reminder": { ... } }`
**Response 403:** el ítem guardado es personal de otro usuario.

parameters.content:
## Integración con Google Calendar
Gobernada por `system_configurations.google_calendar_sync_mode` (Configuración → Calendarios):
- `none` (default): no sincroniza nada.
- `to_google`: app → Google (trigger de Postgres + relleno horario).
- `from_google`: Google → app (cada minuto importa eventos nuevos y cancelaciones).
- `both`: ambas direcciones.
Cada trigger lee el modo y termina enseguida si su dirección está apagada.

parameters.query: UPDATE appointments SET google_event_id = $1 WHERE id = $2;

SELECT 
    a.id, TO_CHAR(a.start_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as start_datetime,
      TO_CHAR(a.end_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as end_datetime,
    -- Los eventos importados guardan la descripción de Google en notes: se
    -- devuelve esa para no borrarla al actualizar el evento.
    CASE WHEN a.imported_from_google THEN COALESCE(a.description, a.notes) ELSE a.description END AS description,
    a.summary, a.color, 
    a.calendar_source_id, a.google_event_id, a.status, a.updated_at,
    -- Recién importada de Google y sin cambios en la app: no hay nada que empujar
    -- (evita el eco Google → app → Google en modo both).
    (a.imported_from_google IS TRUE AND a.updated_at = a.created_at) AS is_fresh_google_import,
    p.email as patient_email, d.email as doctor_email
FROM appointments a
LEFT JOIN users p ON a.patient_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN users d ON a.assignee_id = d.id
WHERE a.id = $1;

SELECT id, google_calendar_id
FROM public.calendar_sources
WHERE is_active = true
  AND google_calendar_id IS NOT NULL
  AND google_calendar_id <> '';

-- Pull Google → app: solo altas nuevas y cancelaciones (los cambios de
-- horario/título hechos en Google no se reflejan).
WITH cancel_existing AS (
    UPDATE public.appointments
    SET status = 'cancelled', updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE $4::varchar = 'cancelled'
      AND $2::varchar IS NOT NULL
      AND google_event_id = $2::varchar
      AND calendar_source_id = $1::bigint
      AND COALESCE(status, '') NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'deleted')
    RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO public.appointments (
    calendar_source_id, google_event_id, summary, status,
    start_datetime, end_datetime, color, notes, imported_from_google
)
SELECT
    $1::bigint, $2::varchar, $3::text, $4::varchar,
    $5::timestamp, $6::timestamp, $7::varchar, $8::text, TRUE
WHERE $2::varchar IS NOT NULL
  AND $4::varchar <> 'cancelled'
  AND $5::timestamp IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.appointments
    WHERE google_event_id = $2::varchar
      AND calendar_source_id = $1::bigint
  );

	a.description,
	a.status,
	a.cancellation_reason,
	a.cancellation_note,
	a.created_at,
	a.calendar_source_id,
	google_event_id AS google_event_id,
    a.color,
    a.invoice_id,
    a.notes,
    a.quote_id,
    a.imported_from_google,
    q.doc_no,
    COALESCE(s.services_array, '[]'::jsonb) AS services

FROM public.appointments a
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT
        unaccent(lower(btrim($1::text)))                      AS term,
        regexp_replace(coalesce($1::text, ''), '\D', '', 'g') AS phone
) p
INNER JOIN calendar_sources c ON c.id = a.calendar_source_id
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.patient_id
LEFT JOIN users rc ON rc.id = u.responsible_contact_id
LEFT JOIN users d ON d.id = a.assignee_id
-- Subconsulta para agregar los servicios por cada cita
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        asc_t.appointment_id,
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', sc.id,
                'name', sc.name,
                'price', sc.price
            )
        ) AS services_array
    FROM appointment_service_catalog asc_t
    INNER JOIN service_catalog sc ON asc_t.service_id = sc.id
    GROUP BY asc_t.appointment_id
) s ON s.appointment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN quotes q ON a.quote_id = q.id

WHERE c.is_active IS TRUE
  AND a.status <> 'deleted'
  AND char_length(p.term) >= 2
  AND ($2 IS NULL OR $2 = '' OR a.calendar_source_id = ANY (string_to_array($2, ',')::bigint[]))
  AND (
        unaccent(lower(coalesce(a.summary, '')))     LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(a.notes, '')))       LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(a.description, ''))) LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(u.name, '')))        LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(u.email, '')))       LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(u.identity_document, ''))) LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR (char_length(p.phone) >= 3
         AND regexp_replace(coalesce(u.phone_number, ''), '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '%' || p.phone || '%')
     -- Dependiente sin teléfono propio: se lo encuentra por el número de su tutor.
     OR (char_length(p.phone) >= 3 AND u.is_dependant IS TRUE
         AND (regexp_replace(coalesce(rc.phone_number, ''), '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '%' || p.phone || '%'
           OR regexp_replace(coalesce(rc.alternative_phone, ''), '\D', '', 'g') LIKE '%' || p.phone || '%'))
     OR unaccent(lower(coalesce(q.doc_no::text, '')))  LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
     OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM appointment_service_catalog xasc
          INNER JOIN service_catalog xsc ON xsc.id = xasc.service_id
          WHERE xasc.appointment_id = a.id
            AND unaccent(lower(coalesce(xsc.name, ''))) LIKE '%' || p.term || '%'
        )
  )
ORDER BY abs(extract(epoch FROM (a.start_datetime - now()::timestamp))) ASC
LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(coalesce($3::int, 50), 1), 100)

parameters.content:
## Calendar Status Display — Matriz de colores de estado

Configuración → Colores de Calendario. Fila por (clinic_id, calendar_id, status);
`calendar_id` NULL = matriz GENERAL de la clínica, no-NULL = override de ese
calendario (`calendar_sources.id`). Instalación single-tenant: no hay clinic_id
en el JWT, así que `clinic_id` se resuelve con `(SELECT id FROM public.clinic LIMIT 1)`.

**GET** `/webhook/calendar_status_display/search`
Devuelve todas las filas de la clínica (general + overrides).
```json
[{ "calendar_id": null, "status": "scheduled", "color": "#a78bfa", "calendar_mode": "always", "badge_style": "solid" }, …]
```

**POST** `/webhook/calendar_status_display/upsert`
Acepta cualquier subconjunto de filas: desde una sola (editar un estado de un
calendario puntual) hasta la matriz general completa o su réplica a N
calendarios. La query hace INSERT … ON CONFLICT con dos CTEs en un único
statement (filas generales vs. de override), porque son dos índices parciales
distintos y no se puede apuntar a los dos con un solo ON CONFLICT.
```json
{ "rows": [{ "calendar_id": null, "status": "scheduled", "color": "#a78bfa", "calendar_mode": "always", "badge_style": "solid" }, …] }
```

**POST** `/webhook/calendar_status_display/delete`
Sin `status`: borra TODO el override de un calendario ("Volver a usar la
general"). Con `status`: borra solo esa fila, para que ese estado puntual
vuelva a heredar de la matriz general sin tocar el resto del override.
```json
{ "calendar_id": "123" }
{ "calendar_id": "123", "status": "confirmed" }
```

parameters.query:
SELECT
  c.calendar_id::text AS calendar_id,
  c.status,
  c.color,
  c.calendar_mode,
  c.badge_style
FROM public.calendar_status_display c
WHERE c.clinic_id = (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY c.calendar_id NULLS FIRST, c.status;

WITH input_rows AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r(
    calendar_id TEXT, status TEXT, color TEXT, calendar_mode TEXT, badge_style TEXT
  )
),
general AS (
  INSERT INTO public.calendar_status_display (clinic_id, calendar_id, status, color, calendar_mode, badge_style)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), NULL, r.status, r.color, r.calendar_mode, r.badge_style
  FROM input_rows r
  WHERE r.calendar_id IS NULL
  ON CONFLICT (clinic_id, status) WHERE calendar_id IS NULL
  DO UPDATE SET color = EXCLUDED.color, calendar_mode = EXCLUDED.calendar_mode, badge_style = EXCLUDED.badge_style, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
),
overrides AS (
  INSERT INTO public.calendar_status_display (clinic_id, calendar_id, status, color, calendar_mode, badge_style)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), r.calendar_id::bigint, r.status, r.color, r.calendar_mode, r.badge_style
  FROM input_rows r
  WHERE r.calendar_id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (clinic_id, calendar_id, status) WHERE calendar_id IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET color = EXCLUDED.color, calendar_mode = EXCLUDED.calendar_mode, badge_style = EXCLUDED.badge_style, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM general)   AS general_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM overrides) AS override_rows;

DELETE FROM public.calendar_status_display
WHERE clinic_id = (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
  AND calendar_id = $1::bigint
  AND ($2::text IS NULL OR status = $2::text)
RETURNING id;

parameters.content:
## Calendar Color Source — Origen del color de las citas

Configuración → Colores de Calendario → Origen del color. Define qué niveles de la
cadena de color cuentan al pintar una cita: etiqueta propia > servicio > doctor >
calendario. La etiqueta propia siempre gana y no se configura; los otros tres se
activan/desactivan. Además guarda `view_highlight` (off | subtle | strong | full): cuánto refleja la vista del calendario el color del calendario visible (franja superior / marco + etiqueta / toda la vista teñida). Fila por (clinic_id, calendar_id); `calendar_id` NULL = configuración
GENERAL de la clínica, no-NULL = override de ese calendario (`calendar_sources.id`) que
REEMPLAZA por completo a la general. Instalación single-tenant: `clinic_id` se resuelve con
`(SELECT id FROM public.clinic LIMIT 1)`.

**GET** `/webhook/calendar_color_source/search`
Devuelve todas las filas de la clínica (general + overrides).
```json
[{ "calendar_id": null, "use_service": true, "use_doctor": true, "use_calendar": true, "view_highlight": "off" }, …]
```

**POST** `/webhook/calendar_color_source/upsert`
Una fila por llamada (general u override). Dos CTEs en un único statement porque son
dos índices parciales distintos.
```json
{ "calendar_id": null, "use_service": false, "use_doctor": false, "use_calendar": true, "view_highlight": "subtle" }
```

**POST** `/webhook/calendar_color_source/delete`
Borra el override de un calendario ("Usar General"). La fila general no se puede borrar.
```json
{ "calendar_id": "123" }
```

parameters.query:
SELECT
  c.calendar_id::text AS calendar_id,
  c.use_service,
  c.use_doctor,
  c.use_calendar,
  c.view_highlight
FROM public.calendar_color_source c
WHERE c.clinic_id = (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY c.calendar_id NULLS FIRST;

WITH input_row AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS calendar_id, $2::boolean AS use_service, $3::boolean AS use_doctor, $4::boolean AS use_calendar, $5::text AS view_highlight
),
general AS (
  INSERT INTO public.calendar_color_source (clinic_id, calendar_id, use_service, use_doctor, use_calendar, view_highlight)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), NULL, r.use_service, r.use_doctor, r.use_calendar, r.view_highlight
  FROM input_row r
  WHERE r.calendar_id IS NULL
  ON CONFLICT (clinic_id) WHERE calendar_id IS NULL
  DO UPDATE SET use_service = EXCLUDED.use_service, use_doctor = EXCLUDED.use_doctor, use_calendar = EXCLUDED.use_calendar, view_highlight = EXCLUDED.view_highlight, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
),
overrides AS (
  INSERT INTO public.calendar_color_source (clinic_id, calendar_id, use_service, use_doctor, use_calendar, view_highlight)
  SELECT (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), r.calendar_id::bigint, r.use_service, r.use_doctor, r.use_calendar, r.view_highlight
  FROM input_row r
  WHERE r.calendar_id IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (clinic_id, calendar_id) WHERE calendar_id IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET use_service = EXCLUDED.use_service, use_doctor = EXCLUDED.use_doctor, use_calendar = EXCLUDED.use_calendar, view_highlight = EXCLUDED.view_highlight, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM general)   AS general_rows,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM overrides) AS override_rows;

DELETE FROM public.calendar_color_source
WHERE clinic_id = (SELECT id FROM public.clinic ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)
  AND calendar_id = $1::bigint
RETURNING id;

-- Modo de sincronización con Google Calendar (script 133):
-- none | from_google | to_google | both. Sin la clave ⇒ none.
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT LOWER(BTRIM(sc.value)) FROM public.system_configurations sc
   WHERE sc.key = 'google_calendar_sync_mode' LIMIT 1),
  'none'
) AS sync_mode;

-- Modo de sincronización con Google Calendar (script 133):
-- none | from_google | to_google | both. Sin la clave ⇒ none.
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT LOWER(BTRIM(sc.value)) FROM public.system_configurations sc
   WHERE sc.key = 'google_calendar_sync_mode' LIMIT 1),
  'none'
) AS sync_mode;

-- Modo de sincronización con Google Calendar (script 133):
-- none | from_google | to_google | both. Sin la clave ⇒ none.
SELECT COALESCE(
  (SELECT LOWER(BTRIM(sc.value)) FROM public.system_configurations sc
   WHERE sc.key = 'google_calendar_sync_mode' LIMIT 1),
  'none'
) AS sync_mode;

-- Ventana de reserva del portal. El staff usa este mismo webhook y agenda sin
-- límite, así que sólo se rechaza a quien tiene ÚNICAMENTE el rol de paciente
-- (mismo criterio que isPatientOnly en el frontend). El JWT no trae roles.
WITH caller AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
         AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(trim(r.name)) NOT IN ('paciente', 'patient')) = 0 AS patient_only
  FROM public.user_roles ur
  JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
  WHERE ur.user_id = $1::uuid
    AND ur.is_active IS NOT FALSE
), req AS (
  SELECT public.patient_portal_booking_limit_date() AS limit_date,
         CASE WHEN $2::text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' THEN left($2::text, 10)::date END AS start_date
)
SELECT to_char(req.limit_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS limit_date,
       to_char(req.limit_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS limit_label,
       (NOT caller.patient_only OR req.start_date IS NULL OR req.start_date <= req.limit_date) AS within_window
FROM req CROSS JOIN caller;

-- Ventana de reserva del portal. Este webhook sólo lo usa el paciente sin
-- sesión, así que se valida siempre.
WITH req AS (
  SELECT public.patient_portal_booking_limit_date() AS limit_date,
         CASE WHEN $1::text ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}' THEN left($1::text, 10)::date END AS start_date
)
SELECT to_char(req.limit_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS limit_date,
       to_char(req.limit_date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS limit_label,
       (req.start_date IS NULL OR req.start_date <= req.limit_date) AS within_window
FROM req;
